difficulty_reason: The lemma lifts a map alpha : E^bullet -> F^bullet from a strictly perfect complex through a quasi-isomorphism-like map f : G^bullet -> F^bullet, locally up to homotopy (statement lines 11847-11861). The proof consists of a translation and a triangle argument: the hypotheses on H^j(f) are recognised as the vanishing of the cohomology sheaves of the cone C(f)^bullet in degrees at least a (proof lines 11864-11865), which lets the same-chapter local triviality lemma supply a covering over whose members the composite with the cone map is null-homotopic (proof lines 11866-11869), after which the distinguished triangle attached to the cone turns that null-homotopy into the required lift (proof lines 11869-11877). The non-formal point is the passage from null-homotopy of a composite to a lift. The claim is H2: two standard inputs combined in the right order.
